reset.hint: Everything returns to the seeded state. Because the users table is rebuilt too, you will be signed out.

adminSettings.title: Platform settings
adminSettings.intro: Mall details, promotion pricing, categories and languages. Anything saved here shows on the storefront immediately.

adminSettings.categoriesHint: Add, rename and reorder the category tree
adminSettings.accountHint: Email and password for the account you are signed in as
